rationale: The agent verified the user correctly via full name and zip, viewed the correct account and orders, and provided accurate details: identified the Chicago order, gave the correct tracking number (840887978435), noted the order status as delivered, and confirmed the tablet storage (64GB). However, the agent performed a profile write (updating the default shipping address) without first explicitly asking for and receiving confirmation, which violates the policy requirement to obtain explicit confirmation before any record-changing action. Additionally, when asked if the package was still in transit, the agent deferred to the carrier site instead of clearly restating the system status (delivered) in that turn. The primary fail reason is the unconfirmed write to the user profile.
